name: genpark-personal-agent-respiratory-quotient-fat-max-pacing-skill
title: Respiratory Exchange Ratio (RER) & FatMax Pacing Sentinel Skill
description: Substrate oxidation ratio (fat vs carb kcal/min) from respiratory exchange ratio (RER/RQ), FatMax training zone, and metabolic flexibility score. Built for GenPark (https://www.genpark.ai).

tools.name: calculate_substrate_oxidation_rates
tools.description: Calculate grams and percentages of fat vs carbohydrate oxidation from VO2 (L/min) and VCO2 (L/min).

tools.name: identify_fatmax_endurance_power_zone
tools.description: Identify watt / pace sweet-spot for maximum grams per hour of lipid oxidation to spare glycogen.
